:::{#def-diverges-to-infinity}
#### Divergence of a sequence to infinity

A [sequence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-sequence) $(a_n)$ of [real numbers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers) **diverges to $\infty$**, written $\lim_{n \to \infty} a_n = \infty$,
if for every real number $M$ there is a natural number $N$
such that $a_n > M$ for every $n \ge N$.

:::
